title: Nuclear assets of the 29th Guards Missile Division near Irkutsk
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Nuclear assets of the 29th Guards Missile Division near Irkutsk, about 2011 at Irkutsk, Russia, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: As it so happens, we know that the 29th Guards Missile Division is and long has been a live nuclear-armed mobile ICBM force in Irkutsk.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the 29th Guards Missile Division, a Russian military unit, is and long has been a live nuclear force near Irkutsk, a city in Siberia. He says it operates mobile ICBMs, which are long-range nuclear missiles that can cross continents, and he raises this as background to an account from around 2011 linked to a man named Stephen Pearson. The point, as he frames it, is that strange events seem to happen near nuclear weapons.
